newsitem.title: GERMANY: U.S.-listed Pfeiffer posts record 96 profit.
newsitem.headline: U.S.-listed Pfeiffer posts record 96 profit.

text.p: Vacuum pump manufacturer Pfeiffer Vacuum Technology AG, the first German company to opt for a New York share listing without listing in Germany, on Thursday reported record profits for 1996.
The company posted a 175 percent surge in earnings per American Depositary Share (ADS) to 1.98 marks.
Pre-tax earnings rose 27.1 percent to 100.4 million marks while operating profits rose 124.5 percent to 22 million marks.
The Asslar-based firm's shares, which were priced at $11.50 when they opened in New York last July, rose $1 1/8 on Wednesday to $21 3/8.
Formerly part of the diversified Swiss firm Oerlikon-Buehrle, Pfeiffer makes turbomolecular vacuum pumps, rotary vane pumps, root pumps and customised vacuum systems.
The company is holding a news conference in Frankfurt today.
